judgments.target_text: interpretation of the FORWARD I FRalpha subgroup definition
judgments.value_text: The change from PS2+ to 10X scoring introduced lower-FRalpha-expression patients into the population treated as high expression and was a plausible explanation for the observed subgroup behavior.
judgments.summary: By ESMO 2019, the FORWARD I investigators/sponsor were using the scoring-method change as a contemporaneous explanatory hypothesis for the failed trial's subgroup behavior.

metadata.causal_guard: This records the contemporaneous interpretation only. It does not claim that changing scoring caused later registrational success.

judgments.target_text: next phase III MIRASOL development step
judgments.value_text: The FORWARD I analyses were considered sufficient to support the design of MIRASOL as the next phase III development step.
judgments.summary: The 2019 ESMO presentation preserved a forward development commitment after the FORWARD I failure rather than a hindsight explanation written after later success.

metadata.outcome_guard: Later FDA approval is historically related to this development commitment but is not the same milestone and must not be auto-scored as direct realization.
